title: सुलोचना महाकाव्यमा प्रयोगशीलता
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा महाकवि लक्ष्मीप्रसाद देवकोटाद्वारा लिखित सुलोचना महाकाव्यमा प्रयोगशीलताका बारेमा निरूपण गरिएको छ । प्रयोगशीलतासम्बन्धी सैद्धान्तिक अवधारणाका साथै पूर्वीय तथा पाश्चात्य काव्यशास्त्रका महाकाव्यसम्बन्धी सैद्धान्तिक मान्यतालाई आधार मानी महाकाव्यमा प्रयोगशीलताको खोजी गरिएको छ । महाकाव्यको प्रारम्भ र सर्गबन्धता जस्ता केही पक्षलाई हेर्दा काव्यशास्त्रीय मान्यताको पालना गरिएको देखिए पनि विषयवस्तुको चयन, नायकनायिकाको चरित्रोद्घाटन, रस तथा लयविधान आदि तत्त्वहरूको प्रयोग नवीन किसिमले गरिएको निष्कर्ष निकाएको छ । यहाँ पूर्वीय काव्यशास्त्रले आत्मसात् गरेका सैद्धान्तिक मान्यताहरूलाई प्रायः अस्वीकार गरिएको निष्कर्ष पनि निकालिएको छ । सामाजिक विषयवस्तुलाई अब्गीकार गरी लेखिएको यस काव्यमा समाजका कुपरम्पराका कारण वियोगान्तसम्बन्धी मूल भाव निकै सशक्त र प्रभावकारी बनेको छ । करुण अब्गी रसका रूपमा आएको यस काव्यलाई चरमोत्कर्षमा पुर्‍याउन अब्ग रसका रूपमा आएका अन्य रसहरूले मद्दत गरेका छन् भन्ने निष्कर्षका साथै लयविधानमा समेत प्रयोगशीलता पाइने कुरालाई विश्लेषणात्मक विधिका आधारमा निरूपण गरिएको छ ।
american_english: In this article, experimentalism in the epic 'Sulochana' written by Mahakavi Laxmiprasad Devkota has been expounded. Along with theoretical concepts regarding experimentalism, taking as a basis the theoretical tenets concerning epics in Eastern and Western poetics, experimentalism in the epic has been sought. Looking at some aspects such as the beginning of the epic and the canto-structure, although adherence to poetics tenets appears to have been made, the conclusion has been reached that the selection of subject matter, the revelation of the hero and heroine's character, and the use of elements such as rasa and rhythm have been made in a novel manner. Here, the conclusion has also been drawn that the theoretical tenets embraced by Eastern poetics have been largely rejected. In this poem, written by disregarding social subject matter, the central sentiment relating to tragedy has become very powerful and effective because of society's bad customs. Along with the conclusion that other rasas arriving as subsidiary rasas helped bring this poem, which arrived as karuna (pathos) as the primary rasa, to its climax, the fact that experimentalism is also found in rhythm has been expounded on the basis of the analytical method.

informal_english: This paper's about experimentalism in Mahakavi Laxmiprasad Devkota's epic 'Sulochana'. Alongside the theory around experimentalism, and drawing on Eastern and Western poetics' takes on epics, we've gone looking for experimentalism in the epic. Looking at bits like how the epic starts and its canto-structure, it seems the rules of poetics were followed, but the subject matter chosen, the way the hero and heroine are revealed, and things like rasa and rhythm were used in a fresh way. It also concludes that Eastern poetics' theoretical tenets were pretty much rejected. In this poem, which ignores social subject matter, the tragic central sentiment has become really powerful and effective because of society's bad customs. Other rasas coming in as subsidiary rasas helped lift this poem - which came in as karuna (pathos) as the primary rasa - to its climax, and on top of that experimentalism turns up in the rhythm too, as the analysis shows.
